idle.note: Gentle breathing. AoE2 villagers idle almost still; this keeps a unit from reading as a frozen decal without pulling the eye.

walk.note: AoE contact/pass walk. Shared plant center (no per-ankle orbit stutter). Continuous swing Y. Foot-only ground pin. No root-Y bob. 400 ms.

gather.note: Ground-locked sickle reap. No leg FK. Hips shift BACK on lean (negative root X) so CoG stays over feet. Even ~38° sickle steps, wind-up clears backpack. 1200 ms.

build.note: Overhead strike. Tool arm rises on frame 0, tops out on 1, drives down through 2, lands on 3, settles on 4 and lifts again on 5. The free arm holds the work steady throughout. 1200 ms per cycle.

provenance.method: 2D cutout puppet baked from the painted turnaround
provenance.honesty: Facings 1, 3, 5, 7 are lightly narrowed (0.90) + twisted (3.5°) derivations of a painted view, not painted three-quarter art. Facings 5, 6, 7 are mirrored, which swaps the sickle to the other hand exactly as AoE2's own mirrored facings do. N parts are cut from a mirrorSource back plate so the tool hand matches S without a bake-time flip.
provenance.walkLegs: Walk legs use cyninja-style gait IK (tvanhens/cyninja-prompt-demo): authored foot plant/swing paths, 2-bone hip/knee solve, ankle world-aim that stays flat-to-plantarflex and never dorsiflexes tip-up. Arms/torso remain FK keys.
